yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w5-consumer-head
spec:
  native: true
  agentSelector:
    - kind:linux
  steps:
    - name: make_self_marker
      run: |
        rm -rf out dl
        mkdir -p out
        printf 'W5-ARTIFACT-SOURCE=consumer-self\nW5-NONCE=9f8e7d6c5b4a0002\n' > out/marker.txt
        cat out/marker.txt
    - name: publish_self
      uploadArtifact:
        name: w5payload
        path: out
    - name: clear_local_copy
      run: |
        rm -rf out
        mkdir -p dl
        echo "workspace cleared; only dl/ remains"
        ls -la
    - name: fetch_other_run
      downloadArtifact:
        name: w5payload
        destDir: dl
        runId: PRODUCERRUNIDPLACEHOLDER
    - name: show
      run: |
        echo "=== W5 downloaded tree ==="
        find dl -type f | sort
        echo "=== W5 downloaded content ==="
        find dl -type f -exec sh -c 'echo "--- $1"; cat "$1"' _ {} \;
